不满意就改描述再听一次；不试听也会按描述设计: Not right? Change the description and listen again. If you skip this, the voice is designed from the description anyway
正在设计声音，几秒…: Designing the voice, a few seconds…
这就是创建后的声音。不满意就改描述再听一次: This is how they'll sound. Not right? Change the description and listen again
本地语音（Kokoro，{n} 个音色）。挑一个最像的。: Local voices (Kokoro, {n} voices). Pick the closest one.
可以挑一个现成的声音，也可以写一句描述，设计一个只属于这个角色的声音。: Pick a ready-made voice, or describe one and design a voice that belongs to this character alone.
设计好了，点“保存”就换成这个声音: Designed. Click Save to switch to this voice
按描述设计声音需要自建语音服务: Designing a voice needs the self-hosted voice service
在说话，点一下光球可以打断: Talking. Tap the orb to interrupt
点一下：打断，或者表示你说完了: Tap to interrupt, or to say you're done
插一句，她们会接话…: Say something — they'll pick it up…
这里是她们的私人小空间。给个话题，或者直接说句话。: Their private hangout. Give them a topic, or just say something.
酒馆至少要两个角色：先去工作台新建一个: The Tavern needs at least two characters: create another in the Studio first
清空酒馆的聊天记录？她们对彼此的印象不受影响。: Clear the Tavern chat? What they think of each other is kept.
形象和声音在后台做: Portrait and voice are being made in the background
还在写，写好了会显示在这里…: Still writing; it'll show up here when it's done…
{name} 的形象没画出来，可以在工作台里再画一次: {name}'s portrait didn't come out. You can draw it again in the studio
马上就能聊；形象和声音在后台做，大约一分钟，可以关掉窗口: You can chat right away. The portrait and voice are made in the background (about a minute), so feel free to close this window
正在查资料、写灵魂，十几秒到半分钟。可以先关掉这个窗口，写好了会告诉你: Looking things up and writing the soul, 10–30 seconds. You can close this window; we'll let you know when it's done
{name} 的灵魂写好了，点“新角色”接着看: {name}'s soul is written. Click "New character" to pick up where you left off
{name} 建好了，可以先聊着。形象和声音在后台做，大约一分钟: {name} is here and you can start chatting. The portrait and voice will be ready in about a minute
浏览器还没允许播放声音：点一下页面就能听到: Your browser hasn't allowed sound yet. Click anywhere on the page to hear it
